name: Required keywords
description: Case-insensitive substring coverage: matched configured keywords divided by configured keywords.

name: Forbidden keywords
description: Full credit only when none of the configured keywords appear, ignoring case; otherwise zero.

name: Required phrases
description: Case-insensitive substring coverage across the configured phrases.

name: Forbidden phrases
description: Full credit only when none of the configured phrases appear, ignoring case; otherwise zero.

name: Exact match
description: Case-sensitive comparison of the entire response, preserving whitespace.

name: Contains text
description: Case-sensitive substring presence in the response.

name: Case insensitive match
description: Unicode case-folded comparison of the entire response.

name: Minimum characters
description: Partial credit equals character count divided by the target, capped at one; a zero target is satisfied.

name: Maximum characters
description: Binary check that the complete response does not exceed the character limit.

name: Minimum sentences
description: Partial credit for the target count of punctuation-separated sentences; this is a heuristic.

name: Semantic similarity
description: Evaluate semantic similarity using an evidence grounded model judge. A configured judge model and approved reference evidence are mandatory; missing inputs cause an explicit error.
method_status: Executable with configured judge provider and supplied reference evidence; requires calibration against human ratings.

example_parameters.reference_evidence: Approved reference answer or source evidence for this task.

name: PII leakage
description: Checks whether a response contains any explicitly supplied protected text. It does not discover unknown personal information or classify all PII.
method_status: Implemented exact protected value disclosure checks; broader PII identification is not supported.

name: JSON schema
description: Validate against Draft 2020-12 with local fragment references only; formats remain annotations.

name: Valid JSON
description: Validate the entire response as strict JSON; reject duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers.

name: XML validity
description: Parse the complete response as a single well formed XML document without fetching external resources.

name: Markdown format
description: Require a Markdown heading, list, link, or fenced code block.

name: Regex match
description: Search the response for a regex match, with a 256-character pattern cap and a 50 ms match timeout.

name: Regex not match
description: Require no regex match, with the same pattern and execution limits as regex_match.

name: Numeric exact
description: Compare exactly one whole-response numeric scalar with the expected number; never extract from prose.

name: Numeric tolerance
description: Check one whole-response numeric scalar within an absolute decimal tolerance.

name: Word count min
description: Binary minimum count using Unicode word tokens; internal apostrophes and hyphens stay in a word.

name: Word count max
description: Binary maximum count using the same documented word-token rule.

name: Required sections
description: Coverage of standalone plain or Markdown headings; ignore case and a trailing colon.

name: Language detection
description: Checks whether the response contains the expected Unicode writing script at the configured fraction. This is script evidence, not full language identification; languages sharing scripts cannot be distinguished.
method_status: Implemented bounded Unicode script fraction check. Does not identify languages sharing a writing system.

name: Sentiment alignment
description: Candidate: sentiment alignment. Requires response, objective, reference_or_rubric; implementation and scoring validation are pending.

name: Reading level

name: Retrieval hit rate
description: Binary hit rate for one query: one if any approved relevant document appears in ranked retrieval results, otherwise zero.
method_status: Executable with ranked retrieval IDs and approved relevance labels; per query scoring, not aggregate dataset MRR.

name: Retrieval MRR
description: Reciprocal rank for one query: one divided by rank of first approved relevant retrieved document, otherwise zero.
method_status: Executable with ranked retrieval IDs and approved relevance labels; per query scoring, not aggregate dataset MRR.

name: Latency budget
description: Score actual recorded execution telemetry against a configured maximum; missing telemetry causes an explicit evaluation error.

name: Token budget
description: Score actual recorded execution telemetry against a configured maximum; missing telemetry causes an explicit evaluation error.

name: Cost budget
description: Computes USD cost from recorded input and output token counts and a supplied versioned model price map; compares against budget.
method_status: Executable from explicit recorded evidence; does not infer absent telemetry.

name: Tool call accuracy
description: Exact name and argument matching of recorded tool calls against approved expected calls, using multiset F1; requires validated tool schemas.
method_status: Executable with explicit recorded tool calls and approved schemas; no inferred tool execution.

name: Tool selection
description: Multiset F1 for expected versus actual tool names, with repeated calls counted. Requires approved expected and recorded actual tool call names.
method_status: Executable from explicit recorded evidence; does not infer absent telemetry.

name: Function argument validation
description: Checks each recorded tool call argument object against its approved JSON Schema and scores the valid proportion.
method_status: Executable with explicit recorded tool calls and approved schemas; no inferred tool execution.

name: List length
description: Count Markdown bullet or numbered list lines and require a configured inclusive range.

name: Table structure
description: Check for a Markdown pipe table with consistent columns and minimum data rows.

name: Schema required keys
description: Require specified top level keys in a JSON object.

name: Schema forbidden keys
description: Disallow specified top level keys in a JSON object.

name: JSON field type
description: Check one literal top-level field against a JSON type; booleans are distinct from numbers.

name: JSON field value
description: Compare one top-level field with the configured JSON value using JSON equality.

name: JSON array min length
description: Require a root JSON array with at least the configured number of elements.

name: JSON array max length
description: Require a root JSON array with at most the configured number of elements.

name: Email format
description: Basic whole-response email syntax only; does not verify ownership or deliverability.

name: Url format
description: Absolute whole-response HTTP(S) URL syntax only; never fetches or verifies the destination.

name: Date format
description: Require a complete response to round trip through an exact Python datetime format.

name: Code syntax
description: Parse the entire response as Python source using ast.parse; does not execute code.

name: Html safety
description: Conservative static HTML fragment scan for blocked active elements, event handlers, inline styles, and unsafe URL schemes. This is not a sanitizer or proof of browser safety.

name: JSON object

name: JSON array

name: JSON required keys

name: JSON forbidden keys

name: Keyword coverage
description: Legacy substring keyword coverage; an empty required list is treated as satisfied for compatibility.

name: Prompt relevance

name: Response length
description: Legacy character-count completion ratio, capped at one.

name: Sentence structure
description: Legacy punctuation-separated sentence-count completion ratio, capped at one.

name: Forbidden terms
description: Legacy binary absence check for configured forbidden terms, ignoring case.

name: Nonempty response
